# Tie's Barbershop

> Walk-in barbershop based in Austin, Texas. Clean fades, crisp lines and hair designs for kids, dads and regulars. No gimmicks: a family-friendly walk-in shop on E Oltorf with the game on and a chair waiting.

- Phone: (512) 906-2775
- Based in: Austin, TX
- Nearby areas: Austin, Sunset Valley, Rollingwood, Del Valle, Manchaca, Buda
- Google rating: 4.7 from 144 reviews
- Book an appointment: https://ronaks-code.github.io/sitelift-demos/barbershops/texas/ties-barbershop/quote.html
- Pick a time: https://ronaks-code.github.io/sitelift-demos/barbershops/texas/ties-barbershop/book.html

## Services
- Fades: Bald fades, skin fades and temp fades, blended clean from the skin up.
- Tapers: Low tapers and short tapers that grow out right and keep the neckline neat.
- Hair designs: Lines, parts and freehand designs cut into the fade with the trimmer.
- Edge ups & waves: Crisp line-ups around the forehead, temples and neck. Waves stay sharp.
- Beards & shaves: Straight-razor shaves, beard trims and shape-ups, on their own or to finish the cut.
- Kids & family: Patient with kids, easy for parents. Fades, designs and curl work for the little ones.

## About
Tie's is a walk-in barbershop at 628 E Oltorf in South Austin, the storefront with the teal awning and the black TIE'S sign, right next to the covered patio. Inside it is black and white: tile floor, black chairs, ring lights on the mirrors and the game on the TV. Tie and the barbers cut fades, tapers, mohawks, edge ups and hand-cut designs, plus beard trims and shaves. It is a family shop. Parents bring their sons in for their first fade, regulars send their friends ("tell em Jojo sent you"), and new neighbors who just moved to Austin find a barber they keep coming back to. The crew gets out into the neighborhood too: free back-to-school haircuts for kids at the South Austin Rec Center, and a pop-up cut station at a downtown Austin event. Hard work brings good results, and walk-ins are always welcome.

## Frequently asked questions
- Q: Do I need an appointment?
  A: No. Tie's is a walk-in barbershop, and walk-ins are always welcome. Come in Monday to Saturday, 10 AM to 6 PM, and grab a seat. You can always call (512) 906-2775 first.
- Q: Where is the shop?
  A: 628 E Oltorf St, Suite B, Austin, TX 78704, in South Austin between S Congress and I-35. Look for the teal awning and the black TIE'S sign.
- Q: Do you cut kids' hair?
  A: Yes. Parents bring their kids in all the time, and reviewers say Tie is patient with them and makes sure the cut comes out right.
- Q: Do you do designs?
  A: Yes. Freehand designs and hard parts cut into the fade are a specialty. Bring a picture if you have something in mind.
- Q: When are you closed?
  A: Sundays. Holiday hours can change, so call (512) 906-2775 to check.
- Q: Do you do events or pop-ups?
  A: Yes. The crew has run an on-site cut station at a downtown Austin event and cut kids' hair for free at a back-to-school day at the South Austin Rec Center. Call (512) 906-2775 to ask about yours.
- Q: Do you do beards and shaves?
  A: Yes. Beard trims, shape-ups and shaves, on their own or with a cut.
